answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 71 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 71 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 410 sponsors, each risking real money. The harbor test is the live device, the tide test is the locked stake, and the inlet test is the graded history no template can fake.
